# CODLEXA

> Transforming ambitious ideas into modern, scalable digital solutions.

CODLEXA is a software engineering and technology consulting company specializing in custom software development, modern web applications, scalable cloud infrastructure, and user-centered digital experiences. We engineer resilient systems using industry-leading stacks including Laravel, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and cloud platforms.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Software Engineering**: Full-cycle software development tailored to complex business requirements and high-concurrency environments.
- **Modern Web Application Development**: Building interactive, reactive, and lightning-fast web applications using React, Inertia.js, and modern APIs.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**: Automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, microservices architecture, and cloud management.
- **UI/UX Design & Spatial Systems**: Clean, human-centered product design, design systems, and responsive interfaces.
- **IT Consulting & Technology Modernization**: Migrating legacy platforms to modern architectures, improving performance, and securing data.

## Technology Ecosystem

- **Backend**: Laravel, PHP 8.3+, REST APIs, GraphQL, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite
- **Testing & Quality**: Pest, PHPUnit, Static Analysis (Larastan/PHPStan), Automated CI
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Linux, Nginx/Apache, AWS/GCP, Google Drive API
